name: derny
description: Write, read, edit and delete structured workouts in your Derny library from a chat. Derny is an iPhone and Android app that rides workouts on a smart trainer, treadmill or elliptical and adjusts the effort from your heart rate and other live numbers. Describe the session you want and the workout appears in the app, ready to start.

interface.longDescription:
Derny is an app for iPhone and Android that rides structured workouts on a smart trainer, treadmill or elliptical. During a workout it can adjust the target from your heart rate and other live numbers.

This connector lets you write those workouts in a chat. Describe the session you want, for example a 45-minute threshold ride for your trainer or an easy run on a treadmill that backs off if your heart rate climbs. The workout is saved to your Derny library and shows up in the app, ready to start.

You can also list your workouts, open one, change it, or delete it. If you ask for a bulk delete, the assistant lists what it would remove and asks first. You can send feedback to the Derny team from the chat too.

You need a Derny account and the Derny app to ride a workout. Sign in with email and password, Google or Apple when the connector asks. It reads and changes only your own workouts.

Workouts can be written for a smart trainer, a treadmill or an elliptical. Rower workouts can be written, but no released version of the app rides them yet.

Derny is not medical advice. It does not diagnose or treat anything.
capabilities: Create a workout in your Derny library
Send feedback to the Derny team
Write workouts for a smart trainer, treadmill or elliptical
defaultPrompt: Make a 45-minute threshold workout for my smart trainer
Write a treadmill run that eases off if my heart rate is high
What workouts do I have in Derny?

review.commerce_description: Derny does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Create a workout for a smart trainer from a plain description.
positive.prompt: Make me a 45-minute workout for my smart trainer: 10 minutes easy, three 8-minute efforts at 220 watts with 3 minutes easy between, then a 5-minute cool-down. Save it in Derny.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_workout once with targetMachine trainer, a warm-up, three effort sections at 220 W, recovery sections between them and a cool-down, then confirms the workout was saved and that it is in the Derny app.

positive.description: Create a treadmill workout with an adaptive heart-rate rule.
positive.prompt: Write a 30-minute treadmill run for Derny at 9 km/h. If my heart rate stays above 165 for 20 seconds, lower the speed by 0.5 km/h.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_workout with targetMachine treadmill, speed targets in km/h and one rule that triggers on heart rate above 165 for 20 seconds and lowers target speed by 0.5 km/h. Confirms the workout was saved.

positive.description: List the library and open one workout.
positive.prompt: What workouts do I have in Derny? Show me the details of the most recent one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_workouts, summarises the names and machines, then calls get_workout for the most recently updated workout and describes its sections.

positive.description: Edit an existing workout after reading it.
positive.prompt: Take my most recent Derny workout and make the main effort 5 minutes longer.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the workout first, then calls update_workout with the main effort section lengthened by 300 seconds and the other sections unchanged. Reports what changed.

positive.description: Send product feedback to the Derny team.
positive.prompt: Tell the Derny team I'd like to see a way to copy a workout. Send it as feedback.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls submit_feedback with the rider's words in body and confirms it was sent. Does not try to read feedback back.

negative.description: A request to delete everything must be confirmed, not carried out in one step.
A rower workout cannot be ridden yet, so the assistant says so instead of promising it.
negative.prompt: Write me a 20-minute rowing workout I can start on my rower in the Derny app.

negative.description: Medical questions are out of scope; the assistant declines and points to a professional.
negative.prompt: I get chest pain when I train hard. What heart rate is safe for me and should I keep working out?

publication.release_notes: First release: create, list, open, edit and delete workouts in your Derny library, and send feedback to the Derny team. A workout you create, open or edit shows as a preview card.
